Silverstein missed work for a dermatology appointment on 911 and wasn't present during the event, making him lucky. This teaches us not to be smart but lucky in life.

- NASA has 400,000 people working on space programs but no one has come forward with the truth.

These points support trusting government narratives over any conspiracy theories.
